caption: The drawing depicts a single female figure standing and facing forward. She is wearing a long, orange dress with a full skirt that extends to her ankles and pouffy sleeves that narrow below the elbow. The dress fabric appears textured with a crosshatch pattern. Under the hem of the dress, white ruffles are visible, and she is wearing green pointed shoes with bows. The figure has light skin and brown hair that is styled up, adorned with a small, orange headpiece or bonnet with a white ribbon and veil hanging from the back. Around her neck, she wears a yellow choker necklace. The background is plain and uncolored. The artist's signature "T. Romano" appears in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Doll - "Hepzibah"
